original_query: Where does the company which was awarded 2400 Patents in 2010 have the IP Transformation Center in Europe?

summaries.found_via_query: Search for companies awarded 2400 patents in 2010 and locate their IP Transformation Center in Europe.
summaries.summary: The page is a Bell Labs presentation by Alcatel-Lucent, highlighting its global reach, heritage of innovation, market impact, and 2010 breakthroughs. It lists 8 countries of presence, key life-changing technologies, 27,900 active patents, and 2010 breakthroughs including lightRadio™, 100G optical transmission, and DSL Phantom Mode.
key_facts: Bell Labs (Alcatel-Lucent) has presence in 8 countries: Belgium, China, France, Germany, India, Ireland, South Korea, United States.
Key life-changing technologies: DSL, PON, WiMAX, WDM, The transistor, Digital signal processing, CCD, Communications satellites, The laser, Cellular telephony.
27,900 active patents and collaboration with >250 universities worldwide.
2010 breakthroughs: lightRadio™, 100G optical transmission, DSL Phantom Mode.
visible_text: BELL LABS INNOVATING AT THE SPEED OF IDEAS
DEFINING THE FOREFRONT OF THE INDUSTRY

summaries.found_via_query: Search for Alcatel-Lucent's IP Transformation Center location in Europe, specifically mentioning the 2010 patent award context.
summaries.summary: This page from Alcatel-Lucent's presentation highlights its mission, leadership quote, and fast facts including its headquarters in Paris, France, annual revenues of €16 billion, 77,000+ employees, and presence in 130 countries. It also lists its R&D budget, active patents (27,900), and 2,400 patents awarded in 2010, along with 7 Nobel Prizes won. The page emphasizes innovation and the speed of ideas.
visible_text: REALIZING THE POTENTIAL OF A CONNECTED WORLD

Broadband everywhere is speeding up life and business. It takes no time to go from having a new idea, to touching peoples lives. We must innovate – and help our customers innovate – at the speed of ideas
